notes.title: 🎮 VoidBound 0.6.7 Beta Release - Exhibition Mode Unveiled
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/9d582d3471234c5e0001fcaa937f72443cf5e540.png"]
It’s time to bare it all- literally!

We’re proud to finally roll out VoidBound 0.6.7 for our STEAM community! This update marks a bold new addition to Caly's journey: the debut of the Exhibition Mode- a feature that lets players fully embrace Caly’s confidence and flaunt it across Henosis.


For Players Continuing with Old Saves:
To access the new quest "An Unexpected invitation", you must have completed:

1) The entire Xaide main quest-line culminating with the quest "A Not So Distant Memory" where Caly wakes up from her coma.

2) You must also have paid a visit to the Auction House and participated in the vase auction event.

If you've already finished these, head to Mr. Fixer in Caly's room and select: ➡️ "Trigger New Content > 0.6.7" From there, choose the quest "An Unexpected Invitation".

Either way, once the player has the quest active, they must zone into the Elite district, walk a few steps forward and then make a u-turn again to try and exit back to the Commercial District. The quest will auto trigger at this point.

⚠️ WARNING: Do not use this feature if you haven’t completed the prerequisite quests. Doing so may break your game and save!


Content Highlights:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/2d7d13582da841dfe40152483d5f82cdd644cceb.png"]

🔥 Exhibition Mode 🔥

If Caly’s gotten her fair share of “hands-on” adventures and built up that Body Confidence by engaging in plenty of erotic events, you’ll now unlock the option to explore in the nude. Whether she’s strolling through the main commercial district or teasing the locals of the slums with nothing but shapely curves, the choice is all yours.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/8b0e21bccd07ccd1043c2ee06589021fad774960.png"]
Expect a range of NPC reactions, from shocked stares to saucy comments, all depending on how much horny they're feeling in the moment. And believe us when we state this: Some of them are not going to be satisfied with just staring. They will pursue.. relentlessly 🙌

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/09783ad3b75b19a5e25b04dd416dd6feb6d9fab5.png"]

🔧 Note on Exhibition Mode:

This is just the first phase of the Exhibition Mode system. While Henosis is the starting point, we're not ruling out plans to expand and evolve this feature further in future updates. More locations, more reactions, and more interactive heat if ideas align! Think of this as the foundation, not the ceiling. 😉

-----------

Our favorite Martian mercenary finds herself back on Xaide again, accepting a job to recover rare eggs from an exotic plant:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/5c384c5e52e40a98fe45fc53c5fc15f00268079d.png"]

Sounds simple, right? But if Caly gets too greedy, she might discover this plant has more than just thorns to defend itself with...

⦁	This quest has prerequisites. Player must have finished the main Xaide questline, as well as participated in the auction of the priceless vase at the Auction House in Elite District.

⦁	A new sub map has been added that is going to serve as an extension of the Auction House itself, housing some priceless artifacts on display.

⦁	Once the quest is available, players can request to visit the display exhibit freely.

⦁	Let’s just say this quest gets messier if she insists on pushing her luck. And yes, plenty of lewd consequences await.

------------------------



-Change Log:-

🔹 New Content: 💡

⦁	✅ New Questline Added : Dive into a fresh side adventure featuring a certain exotic (and dangerously grabby) plant on Xaide.

⦁	🔞 1 New H-Scene : Expect consequences if Caly gets too greedy.

⦁	🎭 9 Exhibition Cut-in Images – Visual reactions to Caly’s boldness have been brought to life with brand new artwork.

⦁	🎨 36 New Sprites – Includes artifacts, paintings, and sculptures to enrich the Auction House's ambience.

⦁	🖼️ New System Graphics – UI and system elements got a visual update.

⦁	🧠 Enemy Patrol AI Rewritten – The entire enemy patrol logic has been rebuilt for smoother, more dynamic behavior.

⦁	💡 Lighting System Overhauled – Improved performance and visual fidelity in key areas of the game.

⦁	🗣️ 60+ New Catcall Lines – NPCs across Henosis have lots to say about Caly showing off her skin.

⦁	🧩 Multi-Branched Dialogue in Exhibition Mode : Some will go beyond than just saying, with their actions fondling louder than words.

⦁	🧍‍♀️ New NPCs for Exhibition Mode – More gawkers, admirers, and commentators populate the world.

⦁	🫦 Birthday Suit Unlocked – Once your Body Confidence stat is high enough, you can now opt to go au naturel and activate Exhibition Mode.


🔹 In-Game Fixes: 🛠️

⦁	Fixed game freeze after intro.

⦁	Fixed Hangar Official repeating both his dialogue and movement route during Corbyn side quest if the player talks to the him again before he returns back to his original spot.

⦁	Fixed an issue where entering the Embassy via Her Indulgence’s brothel route would still trigger the “Find Embassy Entrance ” popup upon entering the Residential area, even after completing the quest. This message will no longer appear, and the guard will now fully abandon his post if the scenario is resolved through this alternate path.

⦁	Fixed double Haar sprite in his room in case players do not accept his hiking invite.

⦁	Fixed Haar's room transition to the newly added floor, instead of one floor below it.

⦁	Fixed Ishan still fighting Caly even after finishing the Slime Quest-line. He will now vanish after player gets access to embassy after talking to Felbig.


🔹 Technical Fixes: 🛠️

⦁	Updated Lovense plugins and gave the device Gush a stronger vibration curve.

⦁	Fixed Idle vibration setting not staying active after changing menu.

⦁	Fixed various minor bugs.

⦁	Fixed various typos.


🔹 Ongoing Development: ⌨️

⦁	Updating plugins for the new caching system that is coming next update (from 6-8 average second loading time to under 1 second!!)

⦁	Progress ongoing towards the next segment of the zone featuring "Space Orcs and Goblins".

------------------------

And that sums up everything for this one!

Thank you, as always, for your continued love and support. This update lets Caly show off her most daring side yet, and we hope you’ll lean into it just as boldly. Better yet, got spicy ideas to make things even hotter? Drop them here or on our Discord, because we’re always listening.

Who knows? We just might turn up the heat a few notches for your pleasure 🔥🌌


Till then though~ enjoy and stay kinky,

Cursed Atelier Team

notes.title: 🎮 VoidBound 0.6.6 Release 🎮
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/7b94981f19b4fc5239c61e397b3968f10280c6d6.jpg

VoidSeekers 👩🏽‍🚀

We’re excited to announce that Update 0.6.6 is now live! This update pushes new scenarios, freshly minted map assets, and full integration of the Lovense system. To celebrate this milestone, we are launching this release with a 25% off discount on the 26th for a limted time!

Content Highlights:
🔧 Lovense Integration: Complete 💈
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/35ddf638033968e712ff1bc89a6792fb88debe6f.gif

What is Lovense?
Lovense is a brand of smart toys designed to sync with games, apps, and other interactive media. With this integration, compatible devices respond dynamically to in-game events, scenes, and dialogues.

How it works in VoidBound:
Once enabled, your Lovense toy will respond in real-time to in-game events—especially during sordidly steamy encounters and lewd twists that arise in combat. It’s fully dynamic: the toy will pulse, vibrate, or tease in perfect sync with the action on screen. Intensity, duration, and pattern shift depending on the situation, ensuring that every encounter feels uniquely personal and intimately reactive.

Steps to make it work:
Open your Lovense Remote App and go to Game Mode.
⦁	Enable LAN and enter your Local IP and Port (20010).
⦁	Hit Connect—if successful, the Connection Status will change to “Connected” and Connected
Devices will list as 1 (supports up to 7 devices at once).

Shoutout to the pioneer: Karryn's Prison by Remtairy
Our Lovense integration wouldn’t exist without the trail blazed by Karryn’s Prison. The system we’ve developed is built on concepts pioneered by Remtairy, who generously gave us the go-ahead to use his work as a foundation. Huge shout out to him for sharing the framework for us to build upon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/8ac1bd36ba69527ff93ee0c42c7dd061252e2c3b.png
"What the hell indeed? What was all of that?! It seems something fishy is going on in the Slums District. Players must investigate!
⦁	This quest has no prerequisites.
⦁	Remember, no good deed goes unpunished
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/b71e13d9659fa1a9bb4ba6fbaac2fb9fb3fd2801.png

Uh oh- Vas is calling in a favor. This can't be good... can it?
⦁	This quest becomes available after completing the Looking for Slimes and Jem's Lost Cargo quest line.
⦁	As Part 1 of an ongoing chain, Caly is set on a wild chase to track down an acquaintance, one that Caly might have a sordid history with, and by proxy get a glimpse into how Vas operates in her mercenary world.

For Players Continuing with Old Saves:
To access the new quest "Hidden Threat", you must first complete "The Slime Saga" by either siding with the HDF or the Slimes. Additionally, you also need to have setup your rig[from Jem's Lost Cargo quest-line] and stream from your room at least once.
If you've already finished these, head to Mr. Fixer in Caly's room and select: ➡️ "Trigger New Content > 0.6.6" From there, choose the quest "Hidden Threat".
⚠️ WARNING: Do not use this feature if you haven’t completed the prerequisite quests. Doing so may break your game and save!

-Change Log:-
🔹 New Content:
⦁	Game is now fully Lovense compatible, including effects during both events as well as combat.
⦁	Added a new questline featuring Caly and Vas.
⦁	Added a new Slum Trap scenario.
⦁	Introduced one new H-scene.

🔹 Fixes & Adjustments:
⦁	Fixed softlock on two doors in Haar's Apartment building.
⦁	Fixed Caly momentarily sliding into an inaccessible room in Haar's Apartment building.
⦁	Fixed double Haar sprites if players turn down Haar's Hiking offer and pick up the BigTrouble quest at the same.
⦁	Fixed an issues in rare cases where players would get duplicate of Wild Branches in Xaide dungeon.
⦁	Fixed an issue where if players left the Evidence room and went to the Residential District instead of the police station during the quest "Deputy for a night", Varyn would not show up at his seat.

🔹 Ongoing Development:
⦁	Working on the next segment of the game featuring "Space Orcs and Goblins"

And that is everything for this update. As always, your feedback helps make VoidBound better, so please be sure to let us know what you think down below or on our Discord!
Fair winds, spacers! 🚀

- Cursed-Atelier Team

notes.title: 🎮 VoidBound 0.6.5 Release 💝
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/8d34468162d8c235e43a12df5073fbb3b904374f.png
Fresh Update Inbound ❤️✨

Love may have filled the air on Valentine's, but now it's Steam's turn to join the fun! The VoidBound 0.6.5 update has arrived—packed with fixes, improvements, and even a bit of fantasizing to keep the mood alive. 😉

Check out the full changelog for all the details.

For Players Continuing with Old Saves:
To access the new quests, you must first complete "Deputy For A Night" and "Virog Char, the Brute of Henosis" quests.

If you've already finished these, head to Mr. Fixer in Caly's room and select: ➡️ "Trigger New Content [0.6.5]"
From there, choose the relevant quests based on your progress.

⚠️ WARNING: Do not use this feature if you haven’t completed the prerequisite quests. Doing so may break your game and save!

Content Highlights:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/261aa1bf5cf5afd9ad5f86329cbb770f96ba8212.png
Haar has gone radio silent, and Jens is starting to worry. Fortunately, Caly has just wrapped up a task and is more than happy to check in on him!


This quest becomes available after completing the Pharmacy Heists Investigation questline.
As part of an ongoing chain, this mission sets the stage for Caly’s deeper dive into the Henosis underworld, with key elements unfolding in the epilogue.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/09f57dd7182b30fdae7db559efec437106e8e950.png
Caly’s constant adventuring is starting to take its toll, pushing her mind into "what if" territory—her latest thought? Having a family. A distant dream, perhaps, but is there another way to experience that feeling and release some of these emotions?


This quest becomes available after completing the bounty for Virog char.
It seems Her Indulgence's establishment is more than just a brothel…what other indulgent secrets does she hide?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/dbe98b870e44b588988fa16a94949af80059c93f.png
Originally a temporary debug feature for niche issues, Mr. Fixer now offers broader usability to help players resolve various in-game problems.


Beyond fixing stray quest log entries and weapon issues, it can now address select bugs that may affect your save. For instance, some players have reported receiving duplicate Xaide branches instead of five unique ones. While we’re still investigating the cause, Mr. Fixer can now correct this issue for affected players.
Additionally, Mr. Fixer now serves as a content trigger too, allowing players continuing from older saves to unlock new content—provided they’ve completed the necessary prerequisite questlines.


-Change Log:-

🔹 New Content:

Added a new questline featuring Caly and Haar.
Added a new holo-pregnancy questline.
Introduced one new H-scene.


🔹 Fixes & Adjustments:

Fixed crafting number being stuck at 1 when creating new items.
Resolved persistent region audio when leaving the Tripteen Dungeon.
Fixed various grammar issues.
Adjusted and fixed the vision cone system for slime enemies.
Fixed an issue where a weapon mod could be purchased more than once.
Assigned sell values to all weapon mods to prevent duplicate clutter.


🔹 Ongoing Development:

Began preparations for the upcoming Lovense update.


----------

This update fine-tunes several areas of the game while pushing us closer to our next big milestone. As always, your feedback helps shape the experience, so be sure to let us know what you think on the STEAM community hub or on our Discord!

Happy adventuring, Voidsurfers! 🚀
- Cursed-Atelier Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/82a646ab6cfce220e4f95548eee11049b7a979a5.png

Greetings VoidBound Community!

We’re thrilled to share some exciting news—our latest game update 0.6.4 is finally ready! 

This update introduces a new branch in the story, sending Caly on a quest to recover a stolen consignment. What begins as a simple retrieval mission quickly escalates into something far more exciting—complete with investigations, naughty collectibles, and a path to internet stardom for our daring heroine.

Content Highlights:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/254dc12df40f1ab0c690b3fc4e78dae99d275ac5.png
Jem, the beauty with a special secret, has returned! This time as the fresh new owner of the Hardware Store located north of the Police Evidence Room in the Commercial District.

Interested players, who would like to pick up her new quest,need to make sure that they have already met her at the disco in Red-light District.
Helping Jem will open up new avenues of fame for Caly, so we highly recommend checking this one out. To make things extra spicy, make sure to also pay a visit to—


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/718d59b1bfe6704f5dad359375c742cd82b166a1.png
Elma, the sex shop owner who has also expanded her services. She will now help Caly attain SIX unique "naughty" toys, provided she has what is needed:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/c9a51181cabda460607220bb51269047a95eee70.png

The first one can be found by simply making your first purchase at Elma's.
One is somewhere on Tripteen. Make sure to explore every nook and cranny for those hidden chests! But, if you can't find all the pieces, perhaps Elma can help?
Two others can be found on Xaide. Rumor has it that a certain merchant holds one and the other one is scattered in pieces all across the dense ruins.
The last two are in Henosis. Seems like a slime has left something behind in the Embassy. Additionally, perhaps a trip to the clinic is on the books as well?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/c1e028b9d7533fe246c24d776627cbbb0b3585f2.png
Kickstart your spicy E-Girl career. Armed with or without your trusty little toys (though it's definitely more fun with them), Caly can amass an internet following that is sure to make her a local celebrity!


-Change Log:-

⦁	New Loading Screen Graphic.
⦁	New Jem Standing art and outfit.
⦁	Changed Hardware store into Jem's Furniture store.
⦁	Added 8 H scenes.
⦁	Updated plugins to allow for upgrades and additions to Setek.
⦁	Added a new quest line from Jem.
⦁	Added 6 collectable dildo's across the whole game.
⦁	Updated Elma in the Sex Store.
⦁	Added Dildo blueprint system.
⦁	Added a new system that will hide choices if requirements are not met yet.

Developer Notes & Instructions:

1) Simply download and unzip the file and double click Game.exe to play the game.

2) If you're confused about the .7z extension, simply install the freeware 7zip software, right click on the downloaded file and hit "Extract here"(If you are on Win11, click "Show more Options" first before finding the "Extract here" command)

3) Saves are backwards compatible should you decide to import your saves from the last update. Copy the save folder from the original and paste it into this one. Continue playing as normal from where you last left off.

-----------

And that is it for this one! Thank you all for your continued support this year and for being such an amazing community! We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the update down below or on our Discord!

Happy holidays and happy gaming!
Cursed-Atelier Team

notes.title: VoidBound 0.6.3 Release!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We're thrilled to announce that the latest content patch for VoidBound is finally ready for STEAM release!

This update brings a ton of new features, improvements, and fixes based on your feedback. Whether you're here for the expanded scenarios, combat tweaks, or shiny new additions, there's something for everyone in this patch.

Below, you'll find a curated change log with everything that’s been added, fixed, and polished.
===========

New Stories: 📖
⦁	Caly and Vas's Girl's Day Out
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/bb4e177b1ea806a70c0fe9344f885c6241dd8e40.png
A Yuri Spa Date with Vas? Sounds innocent enough... right?? Pay Vas another visit at her home in Henosis to find out!
[NOTE: Available AFTER completing the shower event at Vas's apartment.]

⦁	An Exotic Gig 💃🏽
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/d7612ebabd476e350f42a32b49755a9e8fffd7a9.png
Deep Crimson in the Pleasure District is now hiring!
===========

New Additions: 🖌️
⦁	Complete overhaul of Haar's ship, Setek 🚀
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/e1aa36d6a5c7e10ba8473b7ceef39b3699e557b6.png
And when we say overhaul, we really mean it. Check out all the new interior maps!

⦁	Brand New Dialogue Box for better readability 💬
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/fd31e301ee48b2c0e95376946a15ab4f63ffccd1.gif
Compact, concise and easy on the eyes!

⦁	New cut ins, corresponding attacks, and unique dialogues for the Tripteen Boss!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/68fe1293626bc5669c23363a89dfbab7d2a20d7b.png
How about.. no?
===========

New Gameplay Updates: 🗜️
⦁	All major quests have been added to the Quest Log Interface 📝
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/dc486831ebd2a8c74db796f56b0b8aa7fe517988.png
With this, players can now easily track over 40+ quests, with more to be added in the future!

Additionally (with lots of sparkles):
⦁	Enhanced the intro sequence with improved story flow and smoother movement routes. [NEW] Fixed some instances where the star sparkles would turn into circles on interaction.
⦁	Updated the Tripteen dungeon with sparkling animations for interactable objects and smoother event transitions.
⦁	[NEW] Added new environmental sounds in the Tripteen dungeon.
⦁	Refined some Henosis quests for better clarity, highlighting interactable objects, and added new switches for NPCs to offer more varied dialogue based on chosen decision path and quest progress.
⦁	Streamlined the embassy by adding object animations to highlight key items and improved visual effects for the crack in the wall.
⦁	Revised Xaide with clearer objective dialogues and sparkling effects for hard-to-spot interactables. Reworked the laser mechanics in the eastern area of the dungeon, so that players may decide how to proceed.
⦁	Polished the Mind Dungeon with sparkling effects and refined dialogues for better flow and stronger connection to the existing lore.
⦁	Added sparkling effects to most, if not all events, that can be interacted with.
⦁	[NEW] Players can now only carry a maximum of 35 Water Bottles. Additionally, the recovery rate has been reduced, making it less effective than the Trauma Pack, and it can no longer be used during combat.
⦁	Lastly, Nameplate System is now active!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/c192fa6c2c6d40adaad91a64ef19d50d5e5d1509.png
A graphic pop-up will now appear when entering an area, notifying you of your current location.
===========

New Combat Updates: ⚔️
⦁	New powerful skills have been added for Caly's Blaster and SP-42. Beware though, their destructive power comes at the cost of energy and ammo, so choose wisely!
⦁	Overhauled and balanced skill sets as well as combat patterns for normal enemies in the Embassy and Xaide.
⦁	Enemy icons during combat now display numbers to easily identify the next turn order.
⦁	Crafting pages have been added for the sniper and assault rifle.
⦁	Added labels to the weapon modding page so it is easier to see at first glance which part goes where.
⦁	Raised the Orgasm limit to 2, so you can see and enjoy the graphics longer.
===========
New Fixed and Adjustments: 🩹
⦁	Fixed a bug where defeated enemies remained in an alert state after re-entering the dungeon.
⦁	Resolved a crafting bug where equipping a mod no longer displayed as 1/1.
⦁	Fixed text lag after winning combat and receiving items.
⦁	Corrected various issues in the Quest Log.
⦁	Fixed an issue preventing players from loading saved games.
⦁	Adjusted text in several bad endings for clarity.
⦁	[NEW] Fixed Jen's Standing Art not de-spawning after the initial interaction.
⦁	[NEW] Miscellaneous Plugin Optimizations for improved performance.
===========
And that, wraps up the latest content patch notes.

We hope you enjoy these new additions and improvements. Feel free to share your thoughts here or on our Discord as you explore the updated world!

As always, thank you for your continued support—your faith keeps us pushing forward!

With much Appreciation and Regards,
Cursed-Atelier Team

Find Us @ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500710/VoidBound/

notes.title: Early Look: Patch Update Sneak Peek 👀
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44498783/308d1b776f4ff232631160a37609e3cf19200315.png
Hey Voidseekers,

We're thrilled to give you an exclusive sneak peek into what's coming in our next patch update for VoidBound! Your support means the world to us, and we couldn't be more excited to share these upcoming features.

New Maps

Get ready to explore an exciting new environment! A complete revamp of the treacherous Tripteen dungeon awaits with an exciting new layout and interesting additions 😉

Check out the videos below for a glimpse of what's in store!

[previewyoutube=xncVVcd479k;full][/previewyoutube]
x======x


New Battle Cut-In CGs

Prepare for a revisit to the epic automaton battles, now fused with stunning new battle cut-in CGs! We've added a variety of dynamic cut-ins to enhance your combat encounters. Take a peek at the videos below to see them in action!

======
https://i.ibb.co/0QX492w/Cut-in-1.gif
======
https://i.ibb.co/4WX4sdz/Cut-In-Showcase-GIF-2.gif
======
https://i.ibb.co/G9MJj9D/Cut-in-3.gif
x======x


New Renders

We've also been busy creating new renders to enrich your gaming experience! Central among them are designs of the risqué and naughty variety- and yes, our talented artists have poured their hearts into every intricate detail. Take a peek at the latest additions by checking out the images below!

======
https://i.ibb.co/0mh4p4y/win2.png
======
https://i.ibb.co/CQQmVj0/win3.png
x======x


It's all shaping up into an exciting content expansion and we can't wait for you to dive into the next update. Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for VoidBound!

Stay tuned for more updates and announcements in the days to come.

Kind Regards,

Cursed-Atelier Team
